mass_status: Manufacturer listed nominal mass; exact installed battery/deck configuration may differ.
arm_status: The X-frame coordinate offset is fitted data; the radial arm length is sqrt(2) times this value.
inertia_status: Approximation from physical Crazyflie 2.0 system-identification data at a different mass; must be re-identified for this 2.1 configuration.
motor_coeff_status: Dominant quadratic terms converted from the published Crazyflow cf2x_L250 fitted RPM curves. Linear curve terms are omitted in this quadratic runtime model.
maximum_thrust_status: Fitted cf2x_L250 model limit. Maximum RPM is derived from the quadratic runtime k_f and 0.12 N limit; the source RPM polynomial's linear term is omitted consistently with the runtime approximation.
motor_time_constant_status: Symmetric first-order approximation using reciprocal of the published cf2x_L250 spin-up coefficient; asymmetric dynamics are not modeled yet.
aerodynamics_status: Drag area and correlated wind parameters are engineering proxies, not identified Crazyflie 2.1 coefficients. Air density uses the standard sea-level nominal value.

sources.notes: Bitcraze lists the Crazyflie 2.1 at 27 g. The 2.1+ page lists 29 g, so battery/revision differences matter.

Open Crazyflow fitted cf2x_L250 values: L=0.03253 m, thrust/torque polynomials, maximum per-rotor thrust 0.12 N, and spin-up coefficient 7.3556 s^-1. Quadratic coefficients converted from RPM to rad/s. This is a 2.x fitted configuration and is not a manufacturer specification.
Published Crazyflie 2.0 physical-model estimates (Ixx=Iyy=1.43e-5, Izz=2.89e-5 kg m^2); adopted provisionally for 2.1 and 27 g.
Bitcraze lists 92 mm motor-to-motor for 2.1+. The selected axis offset gives 91.9 mm diagonal motor spacing.
